Forecast Discussion

warm Atlantic ridge (aka the Bermuda high) starts to build westward into the Southeast and eventually to the Mississippi River Valley. Heat and humidity gradually build next week as a result.

Drier air arriving from our west limits convection this afternoon. I'll call it widely scattered, with most activity from Grandfather south and drifting toward the foothills by evening. Expect isolated coverage of showers and thunderstorms Saturday afternoon and somewhere between isolated and widely scattered Sunday afternoon. A stray evening shower or thunderstorm is possible this evening and Saturday evening.

Temperatures are seasonal today, a couple of degrees less warm Saturday, but a touch warmer Sunday.

Increasing heat and humidity is the story for Monday through Tuesday. You will need all the home ventilation you can get in non-air-conditioned spaces as we approach record-level heat Wednesday and Thursday. You'd welcome an afternoon shower or thunderstorm, but coverage stays isolated at best until possibly ticking up Thursday.
